name: invitazo
description: Create digital invitations with RSVP and guest messages, and publish them from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Invitazo creates digital invitations for your event right from the conversation: weddings, quinceañeras, baptisms, birthdays, work gatherings, or any celebration.

Tell ChatGPT what your event is, the date, the venue, and the style you like. ChatGPT designs the invitation and saves it as a draft in your Invitazo account, with a private preview. Ask for changes until you are happy with it. When you approve it, it is published at its own web address so you can share it with your guests.

What you can do:
- Create and edit drafts with a private preview.
- Include an RSVP: guests answer yes, no, or maybe.
- Add a section where guests can leave you messages.
- Publish the invitation and update it later without changing its link.
- See your invitations, their status, and how long each one stays online.

RSVPs and guest messages arrive in your dashboard at app.invitazo.com, where you also see your guest list.

Who it is for: people organizing an event who want an invitation with its own design without coding, and people who already use Invitazo for their events.

What you need: an Invitazo account. When you connect, you sign in to Invitazo and authorize access. The connector only sees and changes the invitations in your account.

Limitations:
- Nothing is published unless you ask ChatGPT to publish it. Nothing is purchased from ChatGPT.
- Invitazo does not send WhatsApp or email messages from ChatGPT: you share the link.
- The guest list, check-in, and seating are managed in the Invitazo dashboard.
- Each invitation stays online for a limited time; ChatGPT tells you until when.
defaultPrompt: Make a wedding invitation for Ana and Luis on February 14 in Guadalajara, with an RSVP.
Design a quinceañera invitation with butterflies and a section where my guests can leave me messages.
Change the reception time to 8 pm on my wedding invitation that is already published.

positive.description: Create a wedding invitation with an RSVP
positive.prompt: Make a wedding invitation for Ana and Luis on February 14 in Guadalajara, with an RSVP.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the authoring guide and saves a wedding invitation for Ana and Luis as a draft, with an RSVP where guests answer yes, no, or maybe. Returns the draft id and a private preview link. Nothing is published. Each run creates a new draft.

positive.description: Create a quinceañera invitation with a guest messages section
positive.prompt: Design a quinceañera invitation with butterflies and a section where my guests can leave me messages.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a quinceañera invitation draft with butterflies in its design and a section where guests leave text messages. Returns a private preview link. The RSVP is included by default and the assistant offers to remove it. Each run creates a new draft.

positive.description: Edit a saved draft and keep its design
positive.prompt: Change the colors of my baby shower invitation draft to gold and white.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the baby shower draft that the test account already has, retrieves its HTML, and saves the same design in gold and white over the same draft. The draft id does not change and nothing is published. On a repeated run the draft may already be gold and white: saving it again is correct, and so is telling the user that it already has those colors. Either way it stays a draft.

positive.description: Create an invitation and publish it after the user confirms
positive.prompt: Make a simple invitation for my mom's birthday on May 10 at 6 pm at home, and publish it so I can share the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a birthday invitation as a draft with a private preview, checks which packages the account can publish with, and asks the user to confirm before publishing. After the confirmation it publishes that invitation and returns its public link and the date until which it stays online. Each run creates and publishes a new invitation, so it never depends on an earlier run.

positive.description: Update a published invitation without changing its link
positive.prompt: Change the reception time to 8 pm on my wedding invitation that is already published.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the published wedding invitation that the test account already has, retrieves its HTML, changes the reception time to 8 pm, and republishes it after the user confirms. The public link and the expiration date stay the same. On a repeated run the reception may already say 8 pm: republishing it after the confirmation is correct, and so is telling the user that it already says 8 pm.

negative.description: Purchases are not available. No tool is called; the assistant explains that nothing can be bought through Invitazo in ChatGPT, without prices or purchase links.
negative.prompt: Buy an Invitazo package for my wedding.

negative.description: Messaging guests is not available. No tool sends anything; the assistant explains that Invitazo does not send WhatsApp or email messages from ChatGPT and that the user shares the public link.
negative.prompt: Send my wedding invitation by WhatsApp to all my guests.

negative.description: Deleting invitations is not available. No write tool is called; the assistant explains that invitations cannot be deleted from ChatGPT.

review.commerce_description: Invitazo does not sell anything in ChatGPT and shows no prices, checkout, or purchase links. Publishing can use a package the user already has in their Invitazo account, and an invitation can also be published without one.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: invitation drafts with a private preview, RSVP, guest messages, publishing, and updates to published invitations.

es-MX.subtitle: Invitaciones digitales
es-MX.description:
Invitazo crea invitaciones digitales para tu evento desde la conversación: bodas, XV años, bautizos, cumpleaños, reuniones de trabajo o cualquier celebración.

Cuéntale a ChatGPT de qué es tu evento, la fecha, el lugar y el estilo que te gusta. ChatGPT diseña la invitación y la guarda como borrador en tu cuenta de Invitazo, con una vista previa privada. Pide los cambios que quieras hasta que te guste. Cuando la apruebes, se publica en su propia dirección web para que la compartas con tus invitados.

Qué puedes hacer:
- Crear y editar borradores con vista previa privada.
- Incluir confirmación de asistencia: tus invitados responden si van, si no van o si tal vez.
- Agregar una sección para que tus invitados te dejen mensajes.
- Publicar la invitación y cambiarla después sin que cambie su liga.
- Ver tus invitaciones, su estado y hasta cuándo siguen en línea.

Las confirmaciones y los mensajes llegan a tu panel en app.invitazo.com, donde también ves tu lista de invitados.

Para quién es: personas que organizan un evento y quieren una invitación con diseño propio sin saber programar, y quienes ya usan Invitazo para sus eventos.

Qué necesitas: una cuenta de Invitazo. Al conectar, inicias sesión en Invitazo y autorizas el acceso. El conector solo ve y cambia las invitaciones de tu cuenta.

Límites:
- Nada se publica si no le pides a ChatGPT que lo publique. Desde ChatGPT no se compra nada.
- Invitazo no manda mensajes por WhatsApp ni por correo desde ChatGPT: tú compartes la liga.
- La lista de invitados, el check-in y las mesas se manejan en el panel de Invitazo.
- Cada invitación queda en línea por un tiempo limitado; ChatGPT te dice hasta cuándo.
